user.title: SEC Energy - Select Energy Provider
user.description: Select your electricity distribution system operator from the list.

custom_url.description: Enter the URL to the tariff data in SEC-Energy JSON format.

error.invalid_url: Invalid URL. Must start with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This energy provider is already configured.

init.title: SEC Energy Settings
init.description: Predefined providers use a year map (Jahres-Map) for year-specific URLs. Yearless and custom URLs remain fixed; tariff validity is always checked.

tariff_expired.description: No current tariff is available for {dso} (last validity: {valid_until}). The last known price is retained and marked expired. Check the tariff source or update the integration.
